ROOT.functiondef: CREATE FUNCTION CDN.Str2List (@String varchar(8000)) RETURNS @List TABLE ( Num int ) as begin declare @pos smallint, @num int while @String<>'' begin select @pos = isnull(min(Pos),1) from ( select case when ascii(ltrim(@String)) between 44 and 57 then 1 else 0 end Pos union all select charindex('in (',@String) union all select charindex('between ',@String) union all select charindex('=',@String) ) S where Pos<>0 if substring(@String,@pos,1)='=' begin set @String = ltrim(substring(@String,@pos+1,len(@String))) if charindex(' ',@String)>0 begin insert into @List values (convert(int,substring(@String,1,charindex(' ',@String)))) set @String = substring(@String,charindex(' ',@String)+1,len(@String)) continue end else begin insert into @List values (convert(int,@String)) break end end if substring(@String,@pos,1)='b' begin set @String = ltrim(substring(@String,@pos+8,len(@String))) set @num = convert(int,substring(@String,1,charindex(' ',@String))) set @String = ltrim(substring(@String,charindex(' and ',@String)+5,len(@String))) set @pos = case when charindex(' ',@String)>0 then charindex(' ',@String) else len(@String) end while @num<=convert(int,substring(@String,1,@pos)) begin insert into @List values (@num) set @num = @num+1 end if @pos=len(@String) break set @String = substring(@String,@pos+1,len(@String)) continue end if substring(@String,@pos,1)='i' set @String = ltrim(substring(@String,@pos+4,len(@String))) while charindex(',',@String)>0 and not (charindex(')',@String) between 1 and charindex(',',@String)) begin insert into @List values (convert(int,substring(@String,1,charindex(',',@String)-1))) set @String = substring(@String,charindex(',',@String)+1,len(@String)) end if @String <> '' and isnumeric(@String)>0 begin insert into @List values (convert(int,@String)) break end set @pos = charindex(')',@String) if @pos>0 begin insert into @List values (convert(int,substring(@String,1,@pos-1))) set @String = ltrim(substring(@String,@pos+1,len(@String))) continue end end return end
